purpose: Recovery reference for this Kohler DTV+ installation after a factory reset

captured_at.clock_note: Controller wall-clock minute matched the workstation at capture time, but the controller rendered -0500 while the workstation was on -0400. Correlate error-log entries by local wall clock unless that offset is independently corrected.

source_integrity.safety_source: aaronse/Kohler-DTV-Plus app/server/cgi-safety.mjs: datatable.cgi risk 1/5; debug view; not exposed

restore_semantics.caveat: This is a complete observed values.cgi snapshot, not an automatic replay script. Runtime fields and configuration fields share the same response. Restore through the controller installer UI, changing one setting at a time, then verify against this file.

datatable.warning: This is a read-only recovery snapshot of the full datatable, including volatile runtime and ghost pages. Do not replay it through edit_dt.cgi. Restore named settings through the installer UI and use these values only for verification.
